verdict.rationale: Evidence covers rate limits (RPM/TPM) and a Usage & Cost Admin API for pulling historical spend data, but there is no documentation of a first-party feature to set hard spending caps, budgets, or automated usage alerts that would stop a runaway workload's bill. [2026-09-30 judge-migration owner-product bias audit: reverted opus-5-5 partial q3 -> the committed sonnet-5 baseline none q0. The rationale concedes there is no native spend cap, budget, or alert feature; 'you could build your own alerting' from the Usage & Cost API is workaround inference, and RPM/TPM rate limits bound throughput, not spend. Anthropic-affiliation governance, README §9.]
